title: fix(cli): os datasource introspect --out jail judges the realpath, not the spelling
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbTGhxJSYAmQXU7efVdNqrpw)_
Fixes #33841
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`os datasource introspect --out` 写文件前按解析符号链接后的真实位置判断是否在当前目录内;`--out` 本身是符号链接也拒绝。
- 为什么改:原检查只看路径字面,项目里一个指向外部目录的符号链接就能让服务端生成的草稿写到项目外,且退出码 0。
- 风险与回滚:只动这一个命令的 `--out` 分支;拒绝文案与退出码 2 不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/commands/datasource/introspect.ts` 的 `landsInside`(上溯到最近的已存在目录再 realpath),然后是同目录新测试。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit src/commands/datasource/introspect-out-jail.test.ts`,预期 8 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/cli/src/commands/datasource/introspect.ts`: after the existing lexical check (absolute path, `../` escape; both unchanged), `--out` is judged again on the location the write would really land on:

1. an `--out` that is an existing symlink is refused (`writeFile` follows it, even when it dangles);
2. the realpath of the nearest existing ancestor directory of the target must sit under the realpath of the current directory.

Both refusals reuse the existing message (`--out must be a relative path within the current directory: OUT`) and its exit code 2. A plain relative in-tree path writes as before, also from a current directory reached through a symlink. No directory is created: a missing intermediate directory still fails in `writeFile` with `ENOENT`, as before.

New test beside it, `introspect-out-jail.test.ts` (unit tier: no spawn, no driver), each case in its own temp tree removed in `afterEach`:

- in-tree directory symlink to an outside dir: refused, exit 2, outside dir stays empty;
- target that is an existing (dangling) symlink: refused, exit 2, nothing written outside;
- plain nested in-tree path: writes the server's source;
- cwd reached through a symlink: still writes;
- missing subdirectory: `ENOENT` as before, not the jail refusal, nothing created;
- `../x.object.ts`, `objects/../../x.object.ts` and an absolute path: refused exactly as before.

Changeset: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

## Acceptance notes

- The check and the write are two steps, so a symlink swapped in between them is not caught (time-of-check to time-of-use). The card's threat is a symlink already present in the tree; closing the race would need an `O_NOFOLLOW` open on every path component, which is not what the card asked for.
- The existing lexical prefix check still spells the separator as `/`, so on Windows it reads as refusing every `--out` (read from the code, not run). Unchanged here, noted only; the new check uses `path.sep`.
- The pre-existing `envelope-unwrap.test.ts` also drives this command; these pins went into a new file as the claim's file surface names, not into that one.
